name: 53715 · Madison, WI
findings: ZIP 53715 (Madison) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53715 (Madison) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
